visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair lies on a bed, framed by white pillows. She wears a black top and small earrings. She looks directly at the camera with a bright expression, frequently opening her mouth wide to reveal her tongue as if making sounds. The lighting is soft and warm. (2) The scene continues with the woman laughing and speaking enthusiastically. She shifts her head slightly against the pillows while maintaining eye contact with the camera. Captions appear near her chin. (3) The video cuts to a man with short dark hair lying down in a similar setting. He looks upwards toward the camera, making rhythmic facial movements and sticking out his tongue to simulate a physical process. The background shows a dimly lit bedroom environment. (4) A digital overlay appears behind the man's head, showing a bright blue swimming pool with clear water and glass windows. His face remains central as he continues his exaggerated mouth movements. (5) The man returns to the bedroom setting, squinting his eyes and opening his mouth wide. A cartoon pig snout emoji is briefly superimposed over his nose as he mimics a specific animal behavior. He then laughs and smiles at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat acoustic guitar music with a light steady beat begins. A female voice makes a series of wet, percussive gurgling sounds with her mouth at a rapid rate, followed by short, excited exclamations. (2) The music continues as the female speaker laughs loudly and speaks in a high-pitched, enthusiastic tone. A sharp chime sound effect triggers a transition. (3) A male voice takes over, performing rhythmic 'glugging' and bubbling vocalizations that simulate liquid movement. The tempo of the vocal performance matches the steady BGM. (4) A distinct 'splash' sound effect occurs as the vocal tone shifts to a more narrative, explanatory style. (5) The man performs a series of guttural, snorting sounds with high acoustic intensity, followed by a chorus of laughter from both speakers. The background music maintains its cheerful, constant presence until the end.
